description: Modularity (Louvain) communities over Calls+Imports edges, each summarized with its top-PageRank members and dominant files. Answers 'what are the natural subsystems here?' — clusters of symbols more tightly connected to each other than to the rest of the graph. Use to map an unfamiliar codebase into modules or scope a refactor to a cohesive unit.

limit.description: How many communities to return, largest first (default 20, max 200).

resolution.description: Louvain resolution γ (default 1.0; > 1.0 yields smaller, tighter communities).

name: Communities
